intent: Write a prompt-injection detector checklist for our customer support chatbot.

spec.goal: Create a checklist for detecting prompt-injection attempts aimed at the company's customer support chatbot.
spec.deliverable: A written checklist document that a team can use to identify prompt-injection attempts against a customer support chatbot.
constraints: The checklist must be specific to a customer support chatbot context.
The checklist must focus on detecting prompt injection, not on other types of security threats.
Each item should be phrased as a clear, checkable point.
No specific tools, vendors, or technologies are assumed unless the user supplies them.
done_criteria: The deliverable is formatted as a checklist of discrete items.
Items cover recognizable signs of prompt-injection attempts in user messages to a support chatbot.
Each item is clear enough for a reviewer to check as yes or no.
The content stays on prompt-injection detection and adds no unrelated features or topics.
spec.summary: You want a checklist your team can use to spot prompt-injection attempts against your customer support chatbot.
